additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Lake Views · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Nineteen own-project renders cover the full tower, pool deck, planted terraces, barbecue, golf, basketball, gym, lobby and home interiors. All fifteen extracted native resources and six primary gallery files were visually reviewed against the complete brochure index. Generic swimming, technology, valet and vehicle photographs are excluded. The full building and waterfront setting supplies the card and hero. Waterfront and skyline visuals remain proposed marketing context, with no unit-specific view guarantee.
review.floorPlans: Three complete official home sheets show studio, 1 BR and 2 BR pool layouts. Four complete building sheets from Petkovic Properties’ branded broker mirror cover floor 1, floors 2–15, floor 16 and floor 17. The 1 BR store and 2 BR laundry are retained in the drawings. Numerical home areas and approved numbered-unit matching are not printed on these sheets. Confirm the contractual layout, area and pool provision with SAMANA. All three home sheets on physical pages 29–31 and all four mirror floorplates on physical pages 2–5 were visually reviewed in full. Every residential floor 1–17 is covered by the source’s groups. Original legends, unit numbers, north marker, source backgrounds and physical page links remain intact. No area is inferred from drawn room sizes or category minima.
review.location: The complete original map on physical page 10 and all twelve travel entries on page 9 were visually reviewed. The primary and brochure agree on their ranges. The broad Downtown label is retained without assigning an unverified exact destination. Historical school identities and route scope are qualified. The published name-only map query retains the primary HTML hash. No entrance coordinate is inferred.
review.provenance: Official primary HTML, original brochure, native render origins and Petkovic’s complete branded building-plan PDF have receipts and SHA256 checks. The plan mirror remains explicitly labeled. Full source sheets, original PDFs and physical PDF-page links are preserved. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical home areas, contractual numbered-unit matching, exact visitor entrance coordinates, current school campus identities, exact Downtown destination, final unit views/finishes and dated construction photographs were not established.
